en.name: Venti
en.ability: Each night*, choose a player (different from last night): if they are good, they yield false info and might learn you are in-play until the next dusk. You are an Archon.

revisions.v1: Each night*, choose a player (different from last night): if they are good, they yield false info and might learn you are in-play until the next dusk. You are an Archon.

en.flavor: Oh, the wonders of all creation, I sing for you now: The seasons turn, the four winds never cease. Of course, the credit is not theirs, but mostly mine. For if not for the bard, who would sing of these?
en.otherNightReminder: Wake up Wendy, they point at any player. If the chosen player is good - place the "False Info" tooltip next to the selected player's character token, ST may place the "Chosen" tooltip next to the selected player's character token and learn Venti are in-play. Put Wendy back to sleep.
